text: I really like this dictation app. The fact that it can format all my messy thoughts into a very structured message comes in very handy, and it does amazing wonders for emails, messages, etc. The only time it ever becomes an issue is when it sometimes will not land the message within the text area. The majority of the time it does, but there are some edge cases I've run into where I dictated an entire message and it did not paste it into the message area. otherwise it's awesome!
